findings.detail: The artifact counted 17 flagged rows, but the March 31, 2025 non-accrual disclosure ties to 8 current SOI investment rows; the remaining matched non-accrual rows are December 31, 2024 comparatives.
Sea-K Investors, LLC preferred equity was flagged even though the non-accrual table lists only Kent Water Sports, OneCare Media, Select Rehabilitation, and VardimanBlack Holdings.

rationale: The raw non-accrual table lists four March 31, 2025 portfolio-company amounts totaling cost 47,490 and fair value 26,465: Kent Water Sports, OneCare Media, Select Rehabilitation, and VardimanBlack Holdings. Those amounts tie to 8 current-period SOI investment rows, while the reviewed artifact reports 17 rows by also including December 31, 2024 comparative rows and Sea-K Investors, LLC, which appears in the investment schedule but is absent from the non-accrual disclosure.
